title: How to Build a Restaurant Booking App (Skip the $249/Month OpenTable Bill)
summary: Build your own restaurant reservation system — online booking, table management, and confirmation emails — without code. Skip OpenTable's $249–$499/month fees with Blink.
body_markdown: For most independent restaurants, yes. This system covers online booking, table management, automated reminders, deposits, waitlist management, and customer profiles — the full operational stack. What it doesn't replicate out of the box: the OpenTable consumer discovery network, where diners search for restaurants by neighborhood. If new customer discovery through OpenTable drives meaningful walk-in traffic today, consider running both while you build your direct booking database.
